 THAKOR AMARSINH MAGANJI SINCE DECEASED THROUGH LEGAL  HEIRS & ORS.

==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MRS. JUSTICE  SUNITA AGARWAL  and  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRANAV TRIVEDI  Date : 11/12/2024  ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MRS. JUSTICE SUNITA AGARWAL)
1.

The petitioner herein, impleaded as petitioner No.1.1 namely Arvindsinh Amarsinh claiming to be Thakor Amarsinh Maganji Since Deceased ... vs The Competent Authority Nh No 8 And ... on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128479149/
1 legal heir and representative of Thakor Amarsinh Maganji, whose other heirs are named as Rukshmaniben Amarsinh and Thakor Prahladji Maganji.

The present petition has been filed with the affidavit of the petitioner No. 1.1 herein mentioning his name as 'Arvindsinh Amarsinh Solanki',
aged about 56 years, Religion: Hindu, Occupation: Farming.
The name of the father of the deponent is not indicated in the affidavit.

2. The prayer made in the writ petition is to grant benefit NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/16319/2024 ORDER DATED: 11/12/2024 undefined of Factor 2 for acquisition of land bearing Survey No. 109 of Village: Prantiya, Taluka & District: Gandhinagar, which was acquired vide Notifications dated 25.2.2011 and 21.9.2011 under Section 3A and 3D of the National Highways Act, 1956; respectively and with respect to which award dated 29.2.2011, awarding compensation by applying Factor 1, was passed.

In the original award dated 29.2.2011, the names of the beneficiaries were entered as Arvindsinh Amarsinh, Rukshmaniben and Thakor Prahladji Maganji heirs and legal representatives of Thakore Amarsinh Maganji.

The record indicates that one writ petition namely Special Civil Application No. 19666 of 2023 was filed in the name of Solanki Arvindsinh Amarsinh which was dismissed as withdrawn on the prayer made by the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner with a liberty to file fresh application with better particulars.

3. However, with the assertion made in the present petition, noted hereinabove, it seems that a lot more confusion has been occurred, inasmuch as, the writ petition seems to have been filed by two persons, namely petitioner No.1 as Arvindsinh Amarsinh and the deponent as Arvindsinh Amarsinh Solanki.
When we raised these queries, learned advocate for the petitioner sought time to file a better affidavit to explain the aforesaid circumstances.
4. In the additional affidavit dated 10.12.2024 of Arvindhsinh Amarsinh S/o.
Thakor Amarsinh Maganji, resident of Village: Prantiya, Gandhinagar

, it is sought to be submitted NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/16319/2024 ORDER DATED: 11/12/2024 undefined that the deponent is co-owner of the land bearing survey No. 109, situated at Village: Prantiya, Gandhinagar,
admeasuring 717 + 824 sq. mtrs and name of the father of the deponent is Thakor Amarsinh Maganji.
5.

However, from the perusal of three documents appended with the said affidavit to fix the identity of the petitioner No.1.1 herein, we may note that Aadhar Car appended with the affidavit bears the name Solanki Arvindsinh S/o. Amarsinh, Darbar vas, Prantiya, Gandhinagar, whereas in the Birth Certificate appended at Page-'106' of the paper-book, the name is mentioned as Thakor Arvindsinh Amarsinh.
The copy of the Birth Certificate appended at Page-'106' of the paper-book indicates that it was issued on 6.12.2024 though the date of registration is recorded therein as 1.12.1967.

The third document which is School Leaving Certificate appended at Page-'107' of the paper-book, is dated 30.7.2014, which bears the name as 'Solanki Arvindkumar Amarsinh' and the religion and caste mentioned as Hindu Thakor.
In the PAN Card appended at Page-108 of the paper-book, the name mentioned is Solanki Arvindsinh Amarsinh S/o. Amarsinh Maganji Solanki.

6. From the affidavits filed by the petitioner No.1.1 along with the writ petition dated 6.3.2024 and the additional affidavit dated 10.12.2024, one more fact is relevant to be noted which is the age of Thakor Amarsinh Maganji Since Deceased ... vs The Competent Authority Nh No 8 And ... on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128479149/
2 the deponent.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the first affidavit, the age of Arvindsinh Amarsinh Solanki has been mentioned as 56 years whereas in the additional affidavit, the age of NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/16319/2024 ORDER DATED: 11/12/2024 undefined Arvindsinh Amarsinh S/o. Thakor Amarsinh Maganji is mentioned as 62 years.
There is a third number of age, which is mentioned in the array of parties and petitioner No.1 therein, namely Arvindsinh Amarsinh, Male, has been mentioned as aged about 48 years.

7. In view of these discrepancies found in the record of the writ petition, it is not possible for us to issue a mandamus at the instance of the petitioner who claims to have file the present petition on behalf of all the heirs of Thakor Amarsinh Maganji.

There is no indication in the affidavit that the petitioner No.1.1 namely Arvindsinh Amarsinh has been authorised by other heirs of Thakor Amarsinh Maganji, namely petitioner No.1.2 onwards, to represent their cause.
The affidavit only speaks that the deponent is petitioner No.1.1 hereinabove and is aware of the contents of the writ petition.
8. For all the above noted facts, we do not find it a fit case for grant of mandamus.
The petition is dismissed, accordingly.

However, liberty is granted to the petitioner to approach the competent authority by making a proper application establishing his identity as that of the legal heir and representative of 'Thakor Amarsinh Maganji' and co-owner of Survey No. 109 of Village: Prantiya,
Taluka & District:
Gandhinagar.

9. In case the petitioner approaches the competent authority for fixation of his identity as heir and legal NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/16319/2024 ORDER DATED: 11/12/2024 undefined representative of Thakor Amarsinh Maganji, other heirs and co-owners of Survey No. 109 shall also be joined in the said proceedings and due inquiry shall have to be made after providing notice and opportunity to all the concerned and a reasoned speaking order, in accordance with law, be passed.
10. We, thus, leave it open for the petitioner to approach the competent authority for redressal of his grievance without specifying as to whom the petitioner can approach.
11. Subject to the above, writ petition stands dismissed.
It is clarified that the dismissal of the present writ petition shall not come in the way of the petitioner in any further proceedings.

(SUNITA AGARWAL, CJ ) (PRANAV TRIVEDI,J) SAJ GEORGE Thakor Amarsinh Maganji Since Deceased ... vs The Competent Authority Nh No 8 And ... on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128479149/
